verdict.rationale: The SIP trunking docs show that existing PBX or SIP phone systems can be connected so calls are routed to ElevenLabs agents, which implies inbound call handling. Nothing in the evidence shows provisioning numbers, placing outbound calls, or driving calls through the API. Missing for 10: phone number provisioning or purchase via API, outbound call initiation, API-level call control, explicit inbound and outbound documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
